title: Field study on atmospheric emissions and profiles of heavy metal-containing nanoparticles from multiple full scale industrial sources in China
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1183-1194
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01133G, Paper
Qiuting Yang, Yuxiang Sun, Jianghui Yun, Yujue Yang, Junhao Tang, Guorui Liu
Inhalation of exogenous heavy metal-containing nanoparticles (HM-containing NPs) poses considerable health risks, yet their source-specific industrial emissions remain poorly characterized.
